business_question: What share of directly readable candidate text bytes did Atlas select for bounded Agent content work?
exclusions: binary inputs that require local extraction
limitations: Selected text bytes are not proof that the Agent host read every selected byte.
This metric is not measured model tokens or token savings.
Binary files are excluded; their extracted text is not yet measured in V1.2.
Small samples must be shown with numerator, denominator, and eligible row count.
